title: cyperus fresenii
intro: Cyperus fresenii, commonly known as the Swamp Papyrus, is a plant species that belongs to the family Cyperaceae. This plant is known for its medicinal properties and is used to treat various health issues. The health benefits of Cyperus fresenii include its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which help to reduce inflammation, protect against cell damage, and fight infections. The bioactive constituents of Cyperus fresenii include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which exhibit therapeutic actions such as analgesic, antipyretic, and expectorant effects, making it a valuable plant in traditional medicine.
